assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and intermittent episodes of syncope, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered
This long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study is medically necessary for comprehensive evaluation of the member's symptomatic cardiac episodes
Addressing the payer's denial under PR-204 that this service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
